uiSetup.adaptiveInfoUC: Adaptiv Vanskelighetsgrad: Jo flere Imperiegrupper du klarer å beseire, jo mer forsøker Imperiet å stoppe deg

uiMainApp.eliteUpgradeMsgUC: En eller flere <color="green">Vanlige</color> Utplasseringer har blitt oppgradert til en <color="red">Elite</color> -Gruppe.
uiMainApp.eliteDowngradeMsgUC: En eller flere <color="red">Elite</color> -Utplasseringer har blitt nedgradert til en <color="green">Vanlig</color> Gruppe.
uiMainApp.restoreErrorMsgUC: <color="red">Det oppstod en feil under gjenoppretting av tilstand.</color>
uiMainApp.fame1UC:
Hvis du fullfører oppdraget før slutten av runde 7, kan du kreve antall Utmerkelser som vises.

Etter oppdraget kan Utmerkelser brukes til å:
uiMainApp.fameItem1UC: • Trekke et ekstra Gjenstandskort fra en kortstokk etter eget valg under Rebellenes oppgraderingsfase (kostnad: 1 Utmerkelse per kort).
uiMainApp.fameItem2UC: • Trekke et ekstra Sideoppdragskort og sette det i spill som et aktivt oppdrag (kostnad: 2 Utmerkelser per kort, maksimalt 2 kort).
uiMainApp.fame2UC: Når rundetelleren når 8, settes Oppdragsutmerkelser til 0.
uiMainApp.reinforceWarningUC: Det finnes enten ingen Fiendtlige Grupper å forsterke, eller så er den nåværende Trusselen for lav til å forsterke noen Grupper.
uiMainApp.deploymentWarningUC: Det finnes enten ingen Fiendtlige Grupper å utplassere, eller så er den nåværende Trusselen for lav til å Utplassere noen Grupper.
uiMainApp.noRandomMatchesUC: Ingen matchende grupper med kostnad {d} eller mindre.

sagaMainApp.groupsReadyUC: De følgende gruppene har blitt Klare
sagaMainApp.groupsExhaustUC: De følgende gruppene har blitt Oppbrukt
sagaMainApp.medpacInfoUC:
En helt kan bruke en Medpac når de utfører en hvilehandling, og en alliert figur kan bruke en Medpac som en handling.

Når en figur bruker en Medpac, gjenoppretter den 5 {H}. Medpacs finnes i Crates.
sagaMainApp.optionalDeployPickDpUC: Klikk nå et utplasseringspunkt på kartet:
sagaMainApp.optionalDeployNoGroupsUC: Ingen gruppe tilgjengelig for valgfri utplassering.
sagaMainApp.optionalTacticalAnnounceUC: {0} utplasseres ved {1}. Plasser figurene på utplasseringspunktet.

uiCampaign.threatInfoUC: Trusselnivået er lik som i det sist spilte oppdraget.
uiCampaign.campaignDescriptionUC: Legg ut på en ny eller eksisterende Kampanje gjennom galaksen.
uiCampaign.sagaDescriptionUC: Spill et enkelt, narrativdrevet oppdrag, med en 3D-kartpresentasjon.
uiCampaign.classicDescriptionUC: Spill et enkelt oppdrag ved hjelp av kampanjeguiden din, og uten 3D-kart.
uiCampaign.agendaImperialUC: Imperiet ser deg som en trussel verdt å stoppe. Trekk et kort fra Imperiets Oppdragskortstokk og sett det i spill. Hvis det er et tvunget oppdrag, spilles det oppdraget umiddelbart. Hvis det er et sideoppdrag, blir dette et aktivt sideoppdrag.
uiCampaign.agendaRebelUC: Imperiet bruker sine ressurser andre steder. Ingenting skjer.

uiTacticalAI.apTreeHunter: Focus zone: the area the rebels' current mission objective points at – that is where the hunter hunts. ? Attack point available? Hero INSIDE the focus zone OR moving into it in range and clear line of sight? → attack him (several candidates? → the one with the higher threat value; EXPLAIN shows it). No zone hero reachable, but focus target in range + clear line of sight? → attack the focus target. No attack possible? → this point becomes movement: move up to {0} spaces toward the focus zone resp. the zone hero. ? Attack point(s) spent? Then this point is movement: move up to {0} spaces toward the focus zone resp. the zone hero. The hunter's creed: a hero OUTSIDE the focus zone who is not moving into it is not your target – ignore him, even when he blocks your path. Only whoever attacks YOU may reap your shot back this round; nobody is pursued for it.
uiTacticalAI.apTreeOfficerHunter: ? Attack point available? Order possible? → Which other Imperial figure in reach repositions up to 2 spaces, and where to: toward the focus zone, away from it, or sideways? – the Order spends your attack point and overrides the commanded figure's doctrine. No Order? → Zone hero (working the mission objective inside the focus zone) in range + clear line of sight? → attack yourself; otherwise the focus target, if shootable. Neither Order nor attack possible? → this point becomes movement: hold position, or move up to {0} spaces toward the focus zone. ? Attack point(s) spent? Then this point is movement: hold position, or move up to {0} spaces.
uiTacticalAI.apTreeOfficerKeepHunter: ? Attack point available? Order possible? → Which other Imperial figure in reach repositions up to 2 spaces, and where to: toward the focus zone, away from it, or sideways? – the Order spends your attack point and overrides the commanded figure's doctrine. No emergency? → do not attack on your own. A self-initiated attack is allowed only in one of these emergencies: he is under fire; a hero stands directly beside him; the mission objective is acutely threatened and only he can intervene; or he is the last surviving Imperial group – then he may fight as his doctrine allows. Without an emergency: give your Order, stay in cover behind the group you gave the order to, and do not drift away from it – never move farther from your nearest Imperial ally than it is right now; if no cover can be held, take one step back – never one forward. Neither Order nor attack possible? → this point becomes movement: hold position, or move up to {0} spaces toward the focus zone – never moving farther from your nearest Imperial ally than it is right now. ? Attack point(s) spent? Then this point is movement: hold position, or move up to {0} spaces – never moving farther from your nearest Imperial ally than it is right now.

uiTacticalAI.ordFocusFokuszone: — focus zone: {0} hunts the hero at the mission objective, not the nearest one
uiTacticalAI.ordExplainFokuszone: Focus zone: {0} works the mission objective – {1} (hunter, tier 3+) follows into the zone resp. the hero moving there and leaves heroes outside alone; whoever attacks {1} may expect one shot back.
uiTacticalAI.docGuard: Guard (hold the zone, deny the paths, never be lured out)
uiTacticalAI.docAmbusher: Ambush (stay unseen until the first shot)
uiTacticalAI.overlordFallback: Taktisk KI - Overlord: taktisk verdensmate ennå ikke aktiv - planleggingen følger referansereglene.
uiTacticalAI.specialAsPrinted: Special action: execute exactly as printed on the card.
uiTacticalAI.restLine: Leave this action unperformed: Imperial figures have no Endurance value, so resting would gain them nothing. The figure stays put.
uiTacticalAI.interactLine: Interact: perform an interaction the mission allows (e.g. open an adjacent door, unless the mission has locked it).
uiTacticalAI.focusWounded: he is wounded - finish him first (table damage tracker)
uiTacticalAI.focusFirepower: highest firepower among the remaining heroes (attack dice, then health)
uiTacticalAI.ordAbilitiesLane: Printed special abilities are the Imperium’s call: the attack action may include them exactly as printed (Rules Reference) – the Tactical AI proposes movement and attack only, because deciding “may” abilities needs the board it never sees.
uiTacticalAI.ordFocusDetail: Focus score: {0} = {1} ({2}); basis: {3}; next: {4} — printed hero-card values, wound marks and the mission goal are the only inputs.
uiTacticalAI.ordFocusBasisReaktion: retaliation for the shot on this figure
uiTacticalAI.ordFocusBasisWachzone: guard duty at the mission-critical object
uiTacticalAI.ordPhaseShiftQM: Time runs out: the Imperium leaves its defensive posture and hunts — round {0} of {1} on the mission clock.
uiTacticalAI.ordPhaseExplain: Phase: {0} -> {1} (mission clock in its final third).
uiTacticalAI.ordExplainWachzone: {0} is working at the mission-critical object in {1} — {2} acts first.
uiTacticalAI.ordExplainThreeC: {0} pushed into the newly activated section {1} — {2} reacts first.
uiTacticalAI.ordExplainVergeltung: {0} was shot at this round — {1} is suspected as the shooter.
uiTacticalAI.ordExplainSupportMaske: {0} trusts its picture of {1} and takes aim at the hero reported there.
uiTacticalAI.ordExplainSupportHalten: {0} holds its own section instead of guessing a target — the picture is still too diffuse.
uiTacticalAI.ordExplainClamp: A hero is working at the mission-critical object — the units guard the objective instead of hunting the heroes.

uiTacticalAI.apRule: Read top-down: the first branch answered YES is executed.
